description: This PHP class 'FormatWithDateTime' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format DateTime objects into a specific string format 'Y-m-d H:i:s'. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the maintenance access strategy for formatting values.

classes.name: FormatWithDateTime
classes.description: A class that formats DateTime objects into a string representation for use within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted date-time string if the input is a DateTime object; otherwise, returns null.
